description.quote: The upstream portion of the detector includes planes of graphite, iron and lead interleaved between tracking planes to facilitate the study of nuclear effects in neutrino interactions.
description.value: planes of graphite, iron and lead interleaved between tracking planes upstream of the scintillator tracker

summary.plain: A compact, finely sliced detector sitting just in front of the MINOS near detector at Fermilab. Layers of graphite, iron, lead and water let it compare how neutrinos bounce off different kinds of atomic nucleus.
summary.technical: Finely segmented scintillator-strip inner tracker surrounded by electromagnetic and hadronic sampling calorimetry, with upstream passive targets of graphite, iron and lead interleaved between tracking planes, in the NuMI near detector hall at Fermilab.

technology.quote: The detector is comprised of a finely-segmented scintillator-based inner tracking region surrounded by electromagnetic and hadronic sampling calorimetry.
technology.value: finely segmented scintillator-strip tracker with electromagnetic and hadronic sampling calorimetry and passive nuclear targets
